semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Boston Dynamics provides advanced robotics that can enhance automation and operational efficiency in semiconductor manufacturing environments.
summary: Boston Dynamics specializes in advanced robotics designed to enhance automation in manufacturing and logistics sectors, which are integral to the semiconductor value chain. Their products, such as Spot and Atlas, offer agile mobility and intelligent autonomy for tasks in complex industrial environments, aiming to streamline processes and improve predictability in semiconductor manufacturing.

Atlas for transforming industrial workspaces with strength and versatility
